description: A basic blog platform allowing users to create posts and comments.
vision: To provide a user-friendly platform for individuals to share their thoughts and ideas through blogging with the ability to interact via comments.

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can sign up, log in, and manage their accounts including profile settings.

features.name: Post Creation
features.description: Blog owners can create new posts with text, images, and links. Posts should be categorized for easy navigation.

features.name: Comment System
features.description: Users can leave comments on blog posts. Comments are moderated before being published to prevent spam.

features.name: Search and Filter Posts
features.description: Users can search for specific keywords or filter by categories, tags, and authors.

user_stories.i_want: to create a new blog post with images, text, and links
user_stories.so_that: I can share my thoughts and ideas with the community

user_stories.i_want: to leave a comment on a blog post
user_stories.so_that: I can engage in discussion and provide feedback to the author

user_stories.i_want: to search for posts by keyword or filter them by category
user_stories.so_that: I can easily find relevant content

non_functional_requirements.performance: The system should handle up to 10,000 users simultaneously without significant degradation in performance.
non_functional_requirements.security: User data and posts must be securely stored. Implementing HTTPS is mandatory.
non_functional_requirements.scalability: Design the system with horizontal scalability in mind for future growth.
non_functional_requirements.availability: 99% uptime guarantee, with no planned maintenance windows during peak usage hours.

assumptions: Assume a moderate level of technical expertise among users
Development will take place over 6 months
